To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the overglazed thick-film resistances made of 4312, 4311 and Q870 pastes can withstand 0.1 M pulses at 85 ±10 V/mm, 85 ±20 V/mm and 85 ±5 V/mm, respectively.
the best durability of resistors under pulse load is observed for the overglazed resistive pastes.
the overglazed resistances made of QS870 and 4311 pastes exhibit better durability for long pulses and the overglazed resistance made of QS871 exhibits better durability for short pulses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the pulse duration on the durability of low ohmic resistors.
the durability of resistors made from thick-film pastes under repetitive pulsed load.
the influence of pulse duration on durability of thick-film resistances.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
overglazed thick-film resistances are the best solution for pulsed operation.

overglazed low ohmic thick film resistors can withstand high electric fields and high power densities, when they are stressed by long pulses and when the thermal interface is filled with thermal conductive grease.
the overglaze improves the resistance stability for short pulses, but for long ones the results for overglazed resistive pastes are almost the same as the non-overglazed ones.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best stability of low ohmic resistors is obtained for long pulses and the highest power density is obtained for short pulses.
the overglazed resistive pastes with high thermal conductivity are the most suitable for pulse load with microsecond and millisecond duration.
the durability of low ohmic resistors depends mainly on the thermal interface between the resistor and heatsink.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the overglazing of the resistors made of low ohmic pastes can be used to increase their durability under pulse load.

the resistors can operate under pulse load with micro and millisecond duration, but the pulse duration should be taken into account when the critical parameters of resistors for pulse load are determined.
the durability of thick-film resistances can be improved by using overglaze.
